entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Nagpur Bench At Nagpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The applicant has prayed that First Information Report No.152 of 2014 registered against him for
the offence punishable under Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and for the
offences punishable under Sections 188, 273 and 328 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code
be quashed.
2.  The non-applicant No.1 has filed reply on 03.11.2020.

It is stated that Charge-sheet is filed before Court of learned Judicial Magistrate First Class (Corporation Court No.2), Nagpur vide R.C.C. No.
199 of 2016 on 16.06.2016.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class (Corporation Court No.2), Nagpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Learned Advocate for the applicant states that he is not aware about it as the applicant-accused has not contacted him.

4. Call for R and P of R.C.C.No.199 of 2016 from the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate First Class (Corporation Court No.2), Nagpur.
5.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class (Corporation Court No.2), Nagpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned Registrar Judicial shall ensure that R and P is received by the office of this Court till 14.12.2020.

6. List this Criminal Application for hearing on 15.12.2020 at Serial No.1 at 2.00 p.m. as part-heard.
